applies_why: The judge's UNDERDETERMINED rests on the defender's dropped curse limb and absence of a live link, not on a single verse failing to state a link or its contrary.
quote: D6 vs C4 (Jeremiah 22:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
why: Because the stated ground is the dropped limb/no live link, not the forbidden single-verse ground, the text obeys K-S2.
